name: Cumin Spiced Tofu with Couscous & Orange-Avocado Salad
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
In a medium saucepan, bring broth and spices to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest oranges into a medium bowl, then add oil, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve oranges for the next step.)
Cut off skin and white pith from the oranges; slice between the membranes to release segments. Cut each segment crosswise into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise, then slice into thin strips; add to the bowl.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into two triangles; place on a plate and sprinkle cornstarch and spices over both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tofu and cook, flipping once, until golden brown and crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl with the orange and bell pepper.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide couscous, tofu, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
